details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2146-2162 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrator integration hold posts `ai-review/head-gate` success and exits 0 before `rb_security_merge_gate` (line 2164) runs, bypassing the security gate.
  WHY: An integration head the security gate would hold still gets a green head-gate status, so the orchestrator's final merge may proceed. Severity labels were BLOCKER or MAJOR, and the highest is used.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:100 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ordering assertion `rb_security_merge_gate; then` before `review_head_gate_post_status ... success` fails, because the new hold's status post at review_rb_judge.sh:2147 is now the first match.
  WHY: CI job tests-heal-plan-and-validation fails with an AssertionError, and the assertion encodes a real invariant.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:9243 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts "before reaching main", but `DEFAULT_BRANCH_TRACKING` is empty when the security pass is disabled, so scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25821 emits "the default branch".
  WHY: CI orchestrate-poll shard 3 fails on test_external_finalize_unvalidated_head_is_flagged_and_still_completes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6427-6429 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When validation history is unavailable, the notice reports `validated` if state `validation_last_passed_sha` equals the merged head, instead of saying the status "could not be confirmed".
  WHY: This deviates from the issue's fail-open "could not be confirmed" criterion and is locked in by test_external_finalize_unavailable_history_uses_state_last_passed_sha. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, and the highest (MAJOR) is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25809-25837 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `external_finalize_validation_notice` runs on every external finalize without an `ENABLE_VALIDATION` gate.
  WHY: Repos with validation disabled get a misleading "no successful runtime validation" warning on every external merge. Severity disagreement: most reviewers rated it NIT, minimax rated it MAJOR, and the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16453-16466 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `mark_validation_complete` writes `validation_last_passed_sha` even when the history append did not succeed.
  WHY: The state field can claim a SHA passed that the history never recorded, giving contradictory notices, or "validated" via the state fallback. Severity disagreement: NIT from sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash, MAJOR from minimax, and the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6385-6436 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The header comment of `external_finalize_validation_notice` says "Prints nothing; always returns 0", but the function echoes the `EXTERNAL_FINALIZE_VALIDATION` log line.
  WHY: A future caller that captures stdout would swallow the log line, and the comment is misleading.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When the merged final-PR head SHA has no successful runtime validation in the project's validation history, the completion comment and the Telegram message say so and name the merged SHA and the last validated SHA, if any."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::external_finalize_validation_notice and mark_validation_complete
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The last validated SHA comes only from state `validation_last_passed_sha` (line 6401), which is written only by new `mark_validation_complete` runs (16453-16466), and the history is not scanned for earlier passes, so projects validated before this change report "none recorded".
- requirement: "The hold applies the `ai:ready-to-merge` phase swap to no linked or tracking issue." (from #8232 acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh between the hold marker block (~2106-2162)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The implementation does not explicitly check or document the skipped phase swap, but the reviewer concluded the test and agents fragment show it is met ("NOT a gap").
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
